title: A Lightless Cell
summary: A stone room with no door you can see.
inspect_text: Cold stone closes in on every side. The air is stale and still. When you run your fingers along the wall you find the faintest seam, like a line scored before something is set in place.

features.label: seam in the stone wall
features.inspect_text: The stone is scored by a hairline seam, straight as a ruled line. It could be the work of a door, a panel, or something patient and deliberate.

title: A Corridor of Damp Stone
summary: A low corridor where water has worn the floor.
inspect_text: Water has been here long enough to groove the stone. The air is close and mineral, and the dark swallows sound a step ahead of you.

features.label: groove worn by a drip
features.inspect_text: A slow drip has cut a groove across the floor, patient as any craftsman.

title: A Chamber of Hanging Dust
summary: A still room where dust hangs like a held breath.
inspect_text: Nothing has disturbed the air here in a very long time. Dust hangs motionless in the faint glow of nothing at all.

features.label: motionless dust
features.inspect_text: The dust is so still it seems to be waiting for something to enter and disturb it.

title: A Narrow Passage
summary: A passage so narrow you move sideways.
inspect_text: The walls press close enough to scrape your shoulders. The stone is cold and worn smooth at the height of many hands.

features.label: crack in the floor
features.inspect_text: A thin crack runs the length of the floor, too narrow to lose anything in and too straight to be natural.

title: A Room of Old Ashes
summary: A room where a fire was long ago, and never since.
inspect_text: A dead firepit sits in the center, its ashes cold and undisturbed. The soot on the walls has had decades to settle.

features.label: cold firepit
features.inspect_text: The firepit is swept clean of warmth. Whatever was burned here left nothing behind but ash.

title: A Hall of Broken Chairs
summary: A hall littered with furniture that was broken on purpose.
inspect_text: Chairs lie in pieces, their legs snapped deliberately. Someone was angry here, or someone was testing the strength of things.

features.label: a chair with a broken back
features.inspect_text: The chair's back is snapped clean off. The break is old and the wood has gone grey.

title: A Cellar of Quiet
summary: A low cellar where even your footsteps sound too loud.
inspect_text: The floor is packed earth and the ceiling is barely above your head. The quiet here has weight, like something is listening to it.

features.label: a hollow barrel
features.inspect_text: A barrel stands in the corner. Tapped, it rings hollow and the sound dies too quickly.

title: A Gallery of Blind Arches
summary: A gallery whose arches open onto nothing but wall.
inspect_text: Arches line the walls, and behind every one of them is bare stone. The builder planned doors that were never cut.

features.label: an arch bricked shut
features.inspect_text: Brickwork fills this arch with a care that suggests whoever closed it meant for it to stay closed.

title: A Vault with a Rusted Door
summary: A vault whose door has not moved in years.
inspect_text: A heavy iron door sits flush in the wall, so rusted that the hinges have become one with the frame. It gives slightly under your hand and no further.

features.label: a rusted iron door
features.inspect_text: The door is crusted with rust the color of dried blood. It is locked, or seized, or both.

title: A Den of Cold Draughts
summary: A room where air moves in from somewhere you cannot see.
inspect_text: A cold current of air threads through the room, stirring the dust in slow spirals. It has to be coming from somewhere, but you cannot find the source.

features.label: a wandering draught
features.inspect_text: The draught moves past you and is gone, leaving the room colder for having passed.

title: A Storage Room of Empty Shelves
summary: A storage room where everything has been taken.
inspect_text: Shelves line every wall, and every shelf is bare. Dust outlines where jars and crates once stood, each shape a small monument to something removed.

features.label: empty shelves
features.inspect_text: The shelves are clean of everything except dust. The footprints in it are all yours.

title: A Chamber of Chained Rings
summary: A chamber where rings and chains have been bolted into the floor.
inspect_text: Iron rings are set into the stone at regular intervals, each with a length of chain lying coiled and rusted. Whatever was kept here is long gone, but the room remembers the keeping.

features.label: a bolted iron ring
features.inspect_text: The ring is worn bright where something was tethered to it for a long, long time.

title: A Central Hall of Hollow Stone
summary: A hall whose echoes answer you from too far away.
inspect_text: The room is larger than the dark lets you measure. Every sound you make comes back late, as if it had to travel a long way to bounce off something and return.

features.label: a cracked central pillar
features.inspect_text: The pillar leans a fraction of a degree off true. The crack running down it has not grown in a long time.

title: A Study with No Books
summary: A study that must once have held books, and no longer does.
inspect_text: A writing desk stands against the wall, its surface worn smooth by use. The shelves around it are empty, and the room feels like a memory of reading.

features.label: a worn writing desk
features.inspect_text: The desk is scarred with ink that has dried black and old. The drawer is empty and smells of paper that used to be here.

title: A Guardroom with No Guard
summary: A room built for a sentry who never came back.
inspect_text: A spear rack stands against the wall, empty. A stool sits in the center of the room, arranged to face the door that no one watches now.

features.label: an empty spear rack
features.inspect_text: The rack holds nothing. The brackets where spears once rested are polished bright with use.

title: A Pantry of Rot
summary: A pantry whose stores have long since spoiled.
inspect_text: The smell is old and organic. Shelves of jars hold things that have turned to dark sludge, and the air is thick with the patience of decay.

features.label: a shelf of spoiled jars
features.inspect_text: The jars are sealed but what is inside has gone past mold into something darker. Better not to open them.

title: A Cell of Scraped Walls
summary: A cell whose walls are covered in parallel scratches.
inspect_text: The plaster is gouged with rows of long, parallel scratches, all at the height of a hand held out for balance. Someone walked these walls many times, feeling their way.

features.label: gouged plaster
features.inspect_text: The gouges are deep enough to catch a fingernail. They are old, and they end at the height of a head.

title: A Tunnel with a Low Ceiling
summary: A tunnel you must crouch through, roof close and wet.
inspect_text: The ceiling is low enough that you move doubled over, and damp enough that it has darkened your shoulders. The tunnel curves in a way that makes the next corner always a surprise.

features.label: low oak beams
features.inspect_text: The beams are old and black with moisture. One of them has begun to bow under the weight of the hill.

title: A Rookery of Shadows
summary: A tall room where shadows collect like birds at dusk.
inspect_text: The ceiling is lost in darkness. High on the walls, dark shapes that might be stains or might be nests cling to ledges. The room feels watched, though nothing moves.

features.label: a stain like a roost
features.inspect_text: Up close it is only old stain, but from the floor it looked exactly like something perched and waiting.

title: A Chamber of Bowed Pillars
summary: A chamber whose pillars strain under a weight they were not built for.
inspect_text: The pillars lean inward, their capitals cracked, as if the whole ceiling is slowly pressing down. The room holds its breath under the load.

features.label: a bowed pillar
features.inspect_text: The pillar is bowed enough to notice, its stone grooved with the strain of holding what should not be held.

title: A Trap Room with a Sprung Spring
summary: A room whose trap has already been sprung, long ago.
inspect_text: A plate in the floor is sunk an inch lower than it should be, and the blade that once would have answered it lies broken against the far wall. Someone was here before you, or something was.

features.label: a sprung floor plate
features.inspect_text: The plate is wedged down and will not move. Whatever tension powered it is spent.

title: A Well Room, Dry as Bone
summary: A room built around a well that has not held water in memory.
inspect_text: A stone well stands in the center, its bucket rotted to a hoop of rust. You drop a pebble and count a long time before it lands, somewhere very far below.

features.label: a dry stone well
features.inspect_text: The well is dry but not shallow. Whatever is at the bottom of it is beyond the reach of light.

title: A Passage That Doubles Back
summary: A passage that seems to lead somewhere and then turns on itself.
inspect_text: The passage bends so that you can never see more than a few strides ahead, and when you follow it, the way you came has become the way ahead. It is easy to believe it is moving while you walk.

features.label: a wall that doubles back
features.inspect_text: The wall meets its own shadow at an angle that feels wrong, as if the room were folded rather than built.

title: A Vestry of Lost Prayers
summary: A small room where rituals were once performed, and then abandoned.
inspect_text: A narrow table stands against the wall with a dry stone basin. The air smells of candle wax that burned out long ago. Whatever was prayed for here was not answered.

features.label: a dry stone basin
features.inspect_text: The basin is clean and dry. The wax pooled at its base is the only sign anyone ever used it.

title: A Hall of Sighing Stone
summary: A hall where the stone itself seems to breathe.
inspect_text: The room is bare and the acoustics are wrong. If you stand very still, you can hear the faint, slow sound of air moving through stone, like a chest rising and falling in sleep.

features.label: a stone that sighs
features.inspect_text: Pressing your ear to the slab, the sound is unmistakable: a slow, even rhythm, patient as a held game.
